description: Search Library of Congress Subject Headings (LCSH) by keyword. Returns authorized subject headings and their URIs in a stable paged order, promoting an exact match from the first 50 results to the start; a partial word with no keyword match returns the headings that begin with it. Use the returned label as the subject filter in libofcongress_search_items — LCSH uses precise, standardized terms that differ from natural language (e.g., "World War, 1939-1945" not "World War II"; "Aerial photography" not "Photography, Aerial"). Running this tool before a subject-filtered libofcongress_search_items dramatically improves result quality.

limit.description: Maximum number of subject headings to return. Default 10. A call returns at most 250 headings; a larger limit (up to 1000) returns up to 250.

offset.description: Zero-based position in the matching headings. Continue with next_offset from the previous response.

query.description: Keyword or partial subject heading to search for (e.g., "civil war", "immigration", "jazz").

name: libofcongress_search_subjects

cap.description: The heading limit applied to this response.

effectiveLimit.description: The heading count actually applied when limit exceeded the per-call cap of 250. Absent when limit was within the cap.

effectiveQuery.description: The query as submitted to the id.loc.gov subject suggest endpoint, after trimming.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `request_timed_out`: The Library of Congress subject heading service did not respond within the 50-second request budget. `upstream_unavailable`: The Library of Congress subject heading service could not be reached, or answered with an error status, an HTML page, or an unreadable response instead of its JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_offset.description: Zero-based position to request next. Absent on the final or past-end page.

notice.description: Continuation instructions, a past-end or no-match recovery hint, and disclosure of a capped limit. Absent on an uncapped final page.

shown.description: Number of subject headings returned in this response.

subjects.description: A page of matching LCSH headings in the same order across offsets and limits. An exact match from the initial 50 entries is promoted to the start. To see how many LOC items carry a heading, pass its label as the libofcongress_search_items subject filter and read total.

items.description: A single LCSH subject heading record.

label.description: Standardized LCSH heading — use this exact string in the libofcongress_search_items subject filter.

uri.description: Stable LOC URI identifying this subject heading in the authority file.

truncated.description: True when another page follows. Continue with next_offset to see the remaining headings.

title: Search LC Subject Headings
